question_text: Explain why a telemetry service may compress a large batch of readings before transmission.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A smaller binary representation contains fewer bits. Fewer bits take less time to transmit at the same bit rate and consume less capacity/data allowance.

marking_points.criterion: Reduced time at fixed bit rate.
